mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.person_name AS "personName", a.month, a.classes, a.id_card AS "idCard", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks, a.status FROM swm_person_schedule a WHERE a.id_card = #{idCard} AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
SELECT wg.work_group_name FROM fms_worker w LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON w.work_group_id = wg.id WHERE w.identity_code = #{idCard} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.person_name AS "personName", a.month, a.classes, a.id_card AS "idCard", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks, a.status FROM swm_person_schedule a WHERE a.id_card = #{idCard} AND a.month = #{month} AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC

SELECT id, work_group_name AS "name" FROM fms_work_group
GROUP BY id, work_group_name ORDER BY work_group_name

SELECT w.identity_code AS "key", wg.work_group_name AS "value" FROM fms_worker w LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON w.work_group_id = wg.id WHERE w.identity_code IN
#{idCard}
